nyt100.name: NYT 100 Best of the 21st Century
nyt100.source_note: The New York Times, 'The 100 Best Movies of the 21st Century' (June 2025; voted by 500+ directors, actors and others). Ranks, titles, years (NYT's own, which are US release years, e.g. Oldboy 2005) and IMDb ids taken from the data embedded in the NYT interactive, read from the Internet Archive snapshot of 2025-09-01 because nytimes.com was not reachable directly.

rt300.name: Rotten Tomatoes 300 Best Movies of All Time
rt300.source_note: Rotten Tomatoes editorial guide '300 Best Movies of All Time' (Certified Fresh films ranked by RT's recommendation formula of Tomatometer plus Popcornmeter, with an editorial pass), page marked updated 2025-12-15, fetched 2026-10-21. Years are as RT lists them. IMDb ids resolved through IMDb's suggestion endpoint; 16 matched by hand (e.g. The Decalogue -> Dekalog miniseries, Jalsaghar -> The Music Room).
